PC: Describe possible consequences of the event, including immediate or long term effects
Provide information regarding any tests, procedures, therapies that may be necessary as a result of the event
Provide information regarding changes in level of monitoring or care that may be necessary as a result of the event
Make a plan for managing the patient's condition and comfort
MK: Explain the nature of an unanticipated outcome
Give a factual explanation of what is known to have contributed to an unanticipated outcome
SBP: Offer to obtain support from appropriate health care workers (social workers, clergy, consultants)
Notify the correct people in hospital administration that an error has occurred
Provide adequate documentation in the patient's medical chart regarding the event
Provide appropriate documentation in the patient's medical chart regarding your discussion
ICS: Communicate a statement that an unexpected event occurred
Provide an expression of regret/empathy to the patient and/or family
Answer questions posed by patient and/or family about the medical error
Maintain eye contact at comfortable intervals throughout the interview
PBLI: Communicate that the factors that resulted in the event will be investigated
Describe the steps that will be taken to evaluate contributing factors
Describe the steps that will be taken to prevent recurrences
PROF: Respond to patient/family concerns and expectations
Expresses willingness to be helpful to the patient/family in addressing their concerns
Identify who will communicate with the patient and/or their family on an ongoing basis
